title: Read the sibling spheres as worked examples
summary: The fastest way to internalise the craft is to read the spheres this project already ships, each a different posture worth copying, under current/sphere/ and in repo sources.

siblings.accounting-rigour: a grounded money sphere: articles + corpus, no forced rules, every invariant tied to a real contract and release.
siblings.llm-containment: a grounded doctrine sphere: prompt-boundary, evidence-not-acceptance, observer-never-mutates, plus a few bounded content rules.
siblings.python-best-practices: a portable language sphere: explicit PLABEL reference/canonical, deterministic rules kept minimal, examples that are engine-consumable splices.
siblings.bash-best-practices: a grounded language-plus-doctrine sphere: both pure bash technique and the failure doctrine, quoted to bashqueues files; carries the per-rule assess model it adopted after review.
siblings.gopher toolchain: engine/gopher.py and SPHERES.md define the machinery; qualifying uses sphere resolve/load and profile context.

invariants: Copy a posture by reading its actual pack objects, not by paraphrasing its title.
Notice when two siblings chose different things (rules vs no rules, grounded vs portable) and borrow the one that fits your target.
A companion sphere is a template and a running example of the authoring rules in this sphere.
